title: QUIZ - 51
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Recall the meaning of a given inequality symbol
questions.question: What does the symbol \( > \) mean in an inequality?

options.label: B
options.text: Is greater than or equal to

options.label: D
options.text: Is less than or equal to

questions.explanation: The symbol \( > \) means 'is greater than'.
questions.hint: Each inequality symbol has a specific meaning: greater than, less than, or including equality.

questions.learningObjective: Determine whether a specific value satisfies a given inequality
questions.question: Does t = 3 satisfy the inequality \( t < 9 \)?

options.label: B
options.text: It satisfies the inequality only as an equation.

options.label: C
options.text: No, it does not satisfy the inequality.

options.label: D
options.text: This cannot be determined without more information.

questions.explanation: Substituting t = 3 into \( t < 9 \) gives 3 < 9, which is true.
questions.hint: Substitute the value into the inequality and check whether the resulting statement is true.

questions.learningObjective: Translate a verbal phrase into correct inequality notation
questions.question: Translate into an inequality: "A number t is no more than 4."
questions.explanation: "is no more than" translates to the symbol \( \leq \), giving \( t \leq 4 \).
questions.hint: Match the phrase to its inequality symbol: 'at least' means \(\geq\), 'at most' means \(\leq\), and so on.
